title: Lillstreet Art Center

services.name: Private Events
services.desc: Private classes and workshops are perfect for those who thrive within a personalized learning environment. Whether you are looking to pick up a skill not offered in this session’s catalog or have a preference for one-on-one instruction, our customized courses allow each student to set their own pace and work directly alongside one of Lillstreet’s professional teaching artists. Please note that requests made within three weeks of the preferred event date cannot be accommodated. Allow 48-72 hours response time for event inquiries/correspondence! Additionally, group sizes larger than 12 will be split into two rooms due to size

services.name: Studio Rental
services.desc: Lillstreet is home to over 45 different artist studio spaces. Artist Studios are open to the public, so stop by and see the amazing artwork made right here! Lillstreet Ceramic Group Studios is a unique community of 12 artists working side-by-side at Lillstreet Art Center. Gas, electric, and soda firing are all available (kiln fees are charged separately), and glaze materials are available for purchase at the center. There are currently no open Ceramics Group Studio Spots. Please check back in the future. We will post here when there are available studio spaces.
